title: Split development documentation into several pages
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Simplifying development documentation

Related:
* #2910
* #4596

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Current development pages were far to long to read and understand:

* Split development page into several pages, previous one was far too big to read it briefly
* Nested sections at the left menu buttons caused Prev Page and Next Page buttons to be wrong
* Sections inside development pages are 2nd level now (heading 2) and visible at the right menu 
* Added some missing commands to start development
* Removed links to obsolete `n00b-overview` page and the page itself
* Added documentation for development in Docker and cross links between host and docker installation guides
* Fixed top menu (added link to contribution sections)
* Squashed some sections of introduction page together as they repeated each other
* Some of the headings changed their levels to more consistent structure

Other things will be done in upcoming requests such as:
* Removing `n00b` from file names
* Making shorter version of development pages (aka Quick Start Guide) and updating `CONTRUBITION.md`
* Adding section 'Why use Mermaid'

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [x] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/packages/mermaid/src/docs/community/development.md#3-update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch
author: nirname
